summary_1line: Duryodhana proposes various schemes to weaken or kill the Pandavas, but Karna rejects intrigue and urges a direct military attack instead.

image_candidates.scene_text: In a shadowed royal chamber, Duryodhana leans toward blind Dhritarashtra while whispering schemes against the Pandavas as Karna listens sternly beside him.
Karna, armored and resolute, raises his hand in the Kuru court and boldly urges open war instead of secret plots against the Pandavas.
